TitleAustralian Business Number (ABN)

Definition

An Australian Business Number (ABN) is a unique 11 digit number that identifies a business or organisation in Australia. ABN lookup is available from the offical source: https://abr.business.gov.au/. Changes to this naming system are managed by the Australian HL7 Affiliate (HL7 Australia).
